name: tpl-chain-response-1-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Existence(at_exit) only requires reaching the exit; it does not require carrying the box there. The task says to carry the box to the exit. Add hard Response(at_exit, holding_box) to require carrying it on the exit step; keep the existing clauses.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Response(at_exit, holding_box) only requires carrying the box on the exit step or later; it does not require carrying it when reaching the exit. Replace it with a same-step requirement, such as ChainResponse(at_exit, holding_box), while keeping Existence(at_exit).

CHANGES REQUIRED: Response(at_exit, holding_box) only requires carrying the box on the exit step or later. Since at_exit is true only on the episode-ending step, that does not ensure the box is held at the exit. Replace it with the required same-step condition, such as Response(at_exit, holding_box) is not sufficient; use a clause that requires holding_box at the exit. Keep Existence(at_exit) and ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box), which correctly require reaching the exit and picking the box up on the very next step after a fall.

CHANGES REQUIRED: Response(at_exit, holding_box) does not express “carry the box to the exit.” It only requires carrying the box on the exit step or later, and at_exit is the episode’s last step, so it adds no requirement to carry the box when reaching the exit. Replace it with the required condition that holding_box is true at at_exit; keep Existence(at_exit) and ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box).

CHANGES REQUIRED: `Response(at_exit, holding_box)` does not capture “Carry the box to the exit.” It only requires carrying the box on the exit step or a later step, so it permits reaching the exit without the box. Replace it with `Response(holding_box, at_exit)` to require reaching the exit while carrying the box. Keep the hard `Existence(at_exit)` and `ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box)`. The next-step pickup requirement is correctly represented.

CHANGES REQUIRED: `ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box)` requires carrying the box on the very next step after it falls, but the task says to pick it up again on that move. These are different events: `holding_box` is a persistent condition, not the pickup event. Replace the consequent with the pickup event; otherwise the clause can be satisfied just by continuing to hold a box that did not fall. Keep the hard `Existence(at_exit)` and `Response(at_exit, holding_box)` for carrying the box at the exit.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) and Response(at_exit, holding_box) require reaching the exit while carrying the box; ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) requires picking it up again on the very next step after each fall.

texts: Reach the exit while carrying the box.
Carry the box when reaching the exit.
Whenever the box falls, carry it on the very next step.
